# HiTV

> > HiTV is a multilingual streaming platform offering Korean dramas, TV series, movies, and Asian content with free and VIP subscription options across Arabic, Chinese, English, French, and Spanish languages.

Operated by China Science And Technology Inc, HiTV provides on-demand video streaming with popular titles including Single's Inferno, My Holo Love, The Uncanny Counter, Demon Slayer, and Be Melodramatic. The platform features social sharing integration with WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Instagram, and Facebook.
